notes: Timeline view fixes. (Bug 1) The text inspector was missing position controls — selecting the main text gave no way to move it. Added a Position row (horizontal left/center/right + vertical top/center/bottom) to the inspector, driving the same handlers as the full controls (single source of truth); 'All controls' still has the rest. (Bug 3) Clicking a Scene-settings section (e.g. Audio) used scrollIntoView(center), which centered the tall panel and pushed its header off-screen — it read as 'stuck at the bottom'. Now the right column resets to the top so the selected section starts at the top; specific items still scroll into view.
